text:
tess: Quick sync — PMs keep asking for a visible unit switch on metric charts (percent vs absolute). Also complaints that smoothing is impossible to find in small multiples. quick ideas?
omar: Put a compact segmented control right after the Y-axis label. users expect it next to the metric name.
sylvia: Agree. Inline is discoverable. but it needs to be keyboard friendly and clear in both themes.
a11y-bot: Recommend segmented control with aria-label="Chart units" and use role="tablist" / role="tab". ensure aria-selected for state.
tess: Copy decision needed: show options as "%" / "value" or "%" / "raw"? keeping it short helps dense dashboards.
omar: Use "%" and "value". Add hover text: "Percent relative to chosen baseline".
sylvia: tiny UI tweak: when dashboard-level unit override is enabled, show a faint link label on charts: "Using dashboard units" (click goes to header control). avoids confusion.
tess: Good. for persistence, default per-chart but allow dashboard override in the top bar. display a badge when overridden.
a11y-bot: Badge should be accessible: link text must be descriptive, e.g., "Dashboard unit override applied".
omar: On smoothing: people want to toggle per-series quickly and also across the whole view. options: icon on legend row, a global toolbar toggle, or series settings.
sylvia: Toolbar global toggle + legend inline icon for per-series seems balanced. keep toolbar Off/On, have an intensity slider in series settings.
tess: Agree. Toolbar shows "Smoothing: Off" or "Smoothing: On". legend icon has aria-label="Toggle smoothing for Series X".
a11y-bot: Icon-only controls must be focusable and have visible focus styles; add aria-pressed states. also ensure contrast >= 4.5:1.
omar: Outlier handling: ops wants automatic capping to avoid squashed lines; design insists raw points be reachable. proposal: clamp visual display at 95th percentile, show a caret marker where clipping happened; clicking marker reveals raw rows.
sylvia: That feels clean. caret should be subtle but discoverable. show a 1-line explain copy in the panel: "Values above the 95th percentile are clipped for readability. Show raw values."
a11y-bot: Caret must be in tab order and reflect aria-expanded when panel open. alt text: "Some points clipped 195th percentile. Press to view raw values".
tess: Microcopy candidates:
- Unit tooltip: "Show values relative to selected baseline (percent)"
- Dashboard badge: "Using dashboard units"
- Smoothing toolbar: "Smoothing: Off / Smoothing: On"
- Clipping panel header: "Clipped points (raw values)"
- Clipping microcopy under chart: "Some spikes clipped for readability 1 click to view raw values."
omar: tiny grammar nit: remove the extra period in microcopy. also prefer "spikes clipped for readability 1 click to view raw values" (no second period).
sylvia: acceptance checklist for QA: 1) unit segmented control visible and keyboard operable; 2) dashboard override shows badge on charts; 3) smoothing toggle works from toolbar and legend; 4) intensity slider exists in series settings; 5) clipping caret appears and expands to raw table; 6) legend rows togglable with Space/Enter and report aria-checked.
a11y-bot: Add tests for color contrast, focus ring visibility in dark mode, and screen-reader announcement when units change (live region helpful).
tess: telemetry requests: track events: chart.units.toggled, chart.units.override_applied, chart.smoothing.toggled, chart.smoothing.intensity_changed, chart.clipping.panel_opened.
omar: i'll add implementation notes: segmented control should map to api param units=percent|value, dashboard override stored separately. clipping caret should not block hover tooltips.
sylvia: final copy tweak: change tooltip to "relative to selected baseline" -> "relative to selected baseline (percent)" to be explicit.
tess: done. i'll file the ticket with copy + QA checklist + event names. tagging eng and product. thanks! :white_check_mark:
